display.purpose: Landing hero and the largest page titles only.

headline.purpose: Section headings; the most common large type in the product.

title.purpose: Card titles, panel headings, the EmpathyMeter label.

body.purpose: All prose and conversation text, in Bark Brown, capped at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Badges, nav links, stat rows, captions; medium weight, sentence case.

shadows.name: rest-lift
shadows.purpose: Maximum elevation for an at-rest card or button. Barely-there separation from the cream ground.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Gentle response to hover on interactive cards; pairs with a border deepening to tint-200.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Reserved for genuinely floating elements: the nav pill, speech bubbles, dropdown menus.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Default warm ease-out for celebrations, star pops, and gentle reveals.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Standard duration for button and link color-state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per screen. Gold fill, bark-brown text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #F5B841; color: #2D1E11; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(45,30,17,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E0A030; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD96D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #FFE390; opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second action beside a primary. Brown fill, cream text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #573619; color: #F5F3E8; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(45,30,17,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #3D2817; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B6F47; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis inline action. Gold text, fills tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #A67218; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #FFEDB3; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD96D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content surface: white on cream, warm tinted border, flat at rest.
components.html:
Today's Challenge
Describe what you observed without judgment.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #FFEDB3; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(45,30,17,0.06); color: #2D1E11; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(45,30,17,0.08); border-color: #FFE390; } .ds-card-header { padding: 16px 24px; background: #FFF4D6; border-bottom: 1px solid #FFEDB3; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 24px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Default Badge
components.description: Pill label with a warm tinted border; never a borderless fill.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #FFEDB3; color: #2D1E11; border: 1px solid #FFE390; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 12px; }

components.name: Success Badge
components.description: Positive signal using gentle Growth Green at low opacity.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(127,176,105,0.20); color: #52753C; border: 1px solid rgba(127,176,105,0.40); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 12px; }

components.name: EmpathyMeter
components.description: Signature 0-100 quality bar; band-colored fill on a brown track, framed as a journey not a grade.
components.html:
Empathy Meter72/100 · Good

Minor improvements
components.css: .ds-meter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: #2D1E11; } .ds-meter-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-meter-label { font-weight: 600; } .ds-meter-score { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #A67218; } .ds-meter-track { width: 100%; height: 0.75rem; background: #D4C2A0; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-fill { width: 72%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to right, #FFD96D, #F5B841); border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-meter-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #573619; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-meter-fill { transition: none; } }

components.name: Floating Nav Pill
components.description: Signature glass pill; the one sanctioned glassmorphism surface. Active link is a gold pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.80); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid #FFE390; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(45,30,17,0.12); padding: 8px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #8B6F47; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #FFF4D6; color: #3D2817; } .ds-nav-active { background: #F5B841; color: #3D2817; }

narrative.overview: This is the interface of a kind guide who has all the time in the world for you. Everything about it is warm, unhurried, and wise. The palette is honeyed gold and soft earth-brown over a calm cream ground - the colors of a giraffe's world at low sun, never literal safari cartoon. The user arrives to practice something they are not yet good at, often after a hard conversation, frequently a little raw. The system's entire job is to make that feel safe: generous space, soft edges, gentle motion, and feedback that names what is working before what to improve. The defining discipline is restraint in the service of calm - surfaces are mostly flat, depth comes from warm tonal layering and quiet borders, and one sans family carries the whole hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm earth palette: giraffe gold, bark brown, soft cream - zero cool grays in the core system.
Flat by default; depth via tonal tint layering and 1-2px borders, not shadows.
One sans family across the entire hierarchy; weight and size carry contrast.
Gentle, fixed-radius geometry (8px on cards and buttons, pills on badges and nav).
Feedback is growth-framed: movement from jackal toward giraffe, never a verdict.
Emotional safety leads every decision - calm pacing, soft signals, reduced-motion honored.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Giraffe Gold is the only color that initiates action. If a surface is gold, it is the primary thing to do, the current selection, or a positive signal - never decoration. Two gold buttons competing on one screen means one is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Alarm Rule
rules.body: Feedback colors are warm and gentle by mandate. Gentle Coral (#E07856), never red-500/red-600, carries every low, error, and needs-work state. The product teaches non-judgment; its colors may not flinch.

rules.name: The Warm-Only Rule
rules.body: The core system contains no cool grays. Borders, text, and dividers are brown or gold tints. Stray slate-*, gray-*, and off-palette blue-* are bugs, not choices.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One family, full stop. Hierarchy is built from weight (400 body, 500 label, 700 heading) and size on a calm ~1.2 scale - never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case. No all-caps tracked eyebrows above sections; that scaffolding reads as corporate and breaks the gentle voice.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a tint before a shadow. If two surfaces need separating, layer cream to white to tint-50 or add a tint border. A shadow is the last resort, allowed only when the element truly floats.

rules.name: The Flat-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest (at most shadow-sm). Elevation is a response to state (hover, open, float), never the resting condition of an ordinary card.

dos: Do use Giraffe Gold (#F5B841) only for primary action, current selection, and positive signal - one primary gold button per screen.
Do put Bark Brown text on gold buttons and gold on light grounds via Giraffe Gold Text (#A67218). Verify body text hits >=4.5:1 on cream.
Do convey depth with tonal tint layering (cream to white to tint-50) and warm borders before reaching for any shadow.
Do keep every low-score, error, and needs-work state in Gentle Coral (#E07856) - warm, never alarming.
Do frame all feedback as growth (jackal to giraffe), naming what works before what to improve.
Do use one sans family; build hierarchy from weight and size. Sentence case for headings and labels.
Do give every interactive element the same 8px geometry and the same 2px gold focus ring.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every animation.
donts: Don't introduce cool neutrals or off-palette colors. No slate-*, gray-*, or blue-* - replace with brown/gold tints.
Don't use red-500/red-600 or any saturated red for errors or low scores. Gentle Coral only.
Don't use side-stripe borders - border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent. Rewrite with a full tinted border, a tint background, or a leading number.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient). Use a single solid color; emphasize with weight or size.
Don't look clinical, childish, corporate, or preachy - the four PRODUCT.md anti-references.
Don't add a second typeface or a tracked all-caps eyebrow above sections.
Don't apply shadows to ordinary at-rest cards. Elevation is a response to state or true floating only.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The FloatingNav pill is the single sanctioned glass surface.
